description: This file is a shell script used for testing the compatibility of object formats in git repositories, specifically focusing on SHA-1 and SHA-256 hash functions. It sets up various git repositories, creates commits, tags, trees, and blobs, some signed with GPG, and performs numerous comparisons and verifications to ensure that objects are correctly recognized and consistent across different hash formats.

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Determines the corresponding compatible hash algorithm for a given hash type.

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID of the 'hello' blob for a specified hash type.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID of the tree for a specified hash type.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID of the commit for a specified hash type.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID of the second commit for a specified hash type.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes GPG signature data from commit objects.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes GPG signature data from tag objects.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Performs a series of verification and comparison checks between objects stored in different repositories with different hash formats, including size, type, content, and object identity validations.
